method: principles only; no copied assets, layouts, code, fonts or identity

references.OBSERVED_PRINCIPLE: Brand and product work is presented as one coherent system with a clear point of view.
references.WHY_IT_WORKS: A recognizable idea survives across identity, interface and communication.
references.APPLY_TO_SOS_SF: Treat hydrometry, civic navigation, data-viz and risk content as one visual system.
references.DO_NOT_COPY: Portfolio composition, project imagery, typography, assets or code.
references.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: Use the existing MUNI palette and type family, then create one editorial hierarchy around river measurement.

references.OBSERVED_PRINCIPLE: Design decisions derive from a product-level WHY before visual tactics.
references.WHY_IT_WORKS: It prevents decoration from becoming the concept.
references.APPLY_TO_SOS_SF: Every spacing, type and control decision must improve immediate comprehension, trust or action.
references.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: Adopt Río / regla / tiempo as the single creative direction.

references.OBSERVED_PRINCIPLE: Good product mechanics recede so the user's objective dominates.
references.WHY_IT_WORKS: Reduced interface friction increases focus on content and action.
references.APPLY_TO_SOS_SF: Collapse mobile header controls and move refresh into the hydrometric context.
references.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: Mobile header becomes brand + trust state + menu; secondary controls move to contextual surfaces.

references.OBSERVED_PRINCIPLE: A strong conceptual identifier is carried consistently across mission applications.
references.WHY_IT_WORKS: Complex technical information gains a memorable organizing idea.
references.APPLY_TO_SOS_SF: Use measurement scale, lines and numeric hierarchy as a recurring signature.
references.DO_NOT_COPY: NASA/JPL marks, mission patches, illustrations or layouts.
references.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: The river number and chart become the signature moment without new decorative branding.

references.OBSERVED_PRINCIPLE: Content is prioritized while interface chrome stays deliberately quiet.
references.WHY_IT_WORKS: The product feels calm despite dense underlying capability.
references.APPLY_TO_SOS_SF: Reduce card borders and simultaneous controls around primary data.
references.DO_NOT_COPY: mymind UI, iconography, colors or interactions.
references.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: Use whitespace and rules before boxes; preserve controls behind clear contextual actions.

references.OBSERVED_PRINCIPLE: Large-scale typography and deliberate composition create character without excessive decoration.
references.APPLY_TO_SOS_SF: Treat the measured level as editorial content rather than a dashboard KPI.
references.DO_NOT_COPY: Templates, UI patterns, type choices or layouts.
references.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: Use a larger tabular metric, controlled baseline and quieter metadata.

references.OBSERVED_PRINCIPLE: A product can be expressive while keeping the work itself central.
references.WHY_IT_WORKS: Character and usability reinforce rather than compete.
references.APPLY_TO_SOS_SF: Keep civic trust language while giving hydrometry a distinctive visual rhythm.
references.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: Use MUNI colors and original SOS geometry only; character comes from scale and composition.

references.OBSERVED_PRINCIPLE: Brand decisions scale because rules are systematic rather than one-off screens.
references.WHY_IT_WORKS: Consistency survives across many surfaces and states.
references.APPLY_TO_SOS_SF: Define one touch, type, spacing, color-role and motion system across home, risk and El Niño.
references.DO_NOT_COPY: Spotify brand assets, color system or product components.
references.IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: Create a final HOVS stylesheet that overrides earlier density patches with explicit system rules.
